title: Search: a monotone function of five inputs (shard 08 of 18) where a fan-in-two list with one NOT gate beats every NOT-free list
statement: ¬ (∀ T ∈ ({0xeee0e880, 0xaaaaaaa8, 0xe8e8e8a8, 0xeaa8aaa8, 0xeaa8e8a8, 0xeaaae888, 0xeac8e8c8, 0xeac8eac0, 0xeae8e888, 0xeae8e8c0} : Finset ℕ), ∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (o : ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∀ i j : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → (gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → i = j) → (∀ x : Fin 5 → Bool, PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, o⟩ (List.ofFn x) = Nat.testBit T (∑ i : Fin 5, if x i then 2 ^ (i : ℕ) else 0)) → ∃ (gates' : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (o' : ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates', (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ gates'.length ≤ gates.length ∧ ∀ x : Fin 5 → Bool, PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates', o'⟩ (List.ofFn x) = Nat.testBit T (∑ i : Fin 5, if x i then 2 ^ (i : ℕ) else 0))
unlocks: One shard of the single-output question at 5 inputs: does one NOT gate save a gate on a single monotone output; a saving would show one output already pays for the NOT gate; size 30 to 60 minutes with a SAT solver.
context: SKETCH: the negation search of the shard before it; the route, the classes and the generator are in routes/lgp/own/filing/one-output-5/ (SKETCH.md); work from the row's own sentence. Namespace: PEqualNP.MetaComplexity. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.
